# Self-Maid Cleaning Solutions

> Professional cleaning services serving Montgomery, Prattville, Millbrook, Wetumpka, Selma, Homewood, Clanton, Pike Road, Deatsville, and surrounding Central Alabama communities since 2009.

## Company Overview

Self-Maid Cleaning Solutions is a family-owned and operated cleaning company based in Montgomery, Alabama. Founded in 2009, we have over 16 years of professional cleaning experience and have served 500+ satisfied customers across Central Alabama. We are fully licensed, insured, and bonded. All team members are background-checked.

- Phone: (334) 877-9513
- Email: selfmaidclean@outlook.com

- Service Area: Montgomery, Prattville, Millbrook, Wetumpka, Deatsville, Selma, Homewood, Clanton, Pike Road, Alabaster, and surrounding areas in Central Alabama

## Services and Pricing

### Ongoing Home Cleaning — Starting at $120
Routine residential cleaning. Weekly (15% off), bi-weekly (10% off), or monthly (5% off) options. Includes dusting, vacuuming, mopping, kitchen and bathroom sanitization, and trash removal.

### Detailed Deep Cleaning — Starting at $250
Intensive top-to-bottom cleaning. Includes inside appliances, baseboards, ceiling fans, window sills, grout scrubbing, and cabinet interiors. Takes 4-8 hours.

### Short-Term Rental Turnovers — Starting at $65
Same-day Airbnb, VRBO, and vacation rental turnover cleaning. Linen changes, restocking, quality check photos for hosts. Emergency cleaning available.

### Move-In/Move-Out Cleaning — Starting at $150
Comprehensive cleaning for moving day. Deposit-back guarantee. Inside appliances, cabinets, baseboards, and all surfaces.

### Office Cleaning — Starting at $120
Professional commercial cleaning for offices, retail, medical/dental offices, and professional service businesses.

### Student Dorm Cleaning — Starting at $45
Fast, affordable dorm and student apartment turnovers.

### Multi-Family Turnovers — Starting at $108
Unit-ready cleaning for property managers and landlords. Volume discounts available.

Yes. Self-Maid is fully licensed, insured, and bonded. All team members undergo comprehensive background checks.
